column_assignment: lane i owns block columns c * LANES + i; lane-local column c

reference.rtl_reference: rtl/abi3/ot_a3_lane_pipelined.sv, run once per block lane on that lane's own images

required_marker_prefix: PASS: ABI3 lq8 cases=96 lane_ops=2498935 products=3131522 outputs=19407 faults=18 reference_cases=94 reference_outputs=19407
scale_table_layout: one 8-byte word per lane-local E8M0 index c * (depth / block_b) + k / block_b; byte i holds lane i's code from the global A15 table for block column c * LANES + i
stream_layout: one 16-byte word per block lane-op in the lanes' issue order (row, pass of L interleaved local columns, k-group, column within the pass); lane i's g weight codes at bits [16 i +: 16], code j at [j * width +: width]
